description: This file defines a UI component named 'Details' using LightningJS framework. It renders a detailed view of a recipe, including image, title, ingredients, and steps, and handles data loading states. It imports several components and data-fetching functions, and employs reactive state management.

classes.name: Details
classes.description: A LightningJS component that displays detailed information about a specific recipe, including image, title, ingredients, and steps. Handles loading and error states and includes back navigation.

methods.name: onMounted
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches recipe data by ID when the component is mounted, manages loading and error states accordingly.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Navigates back to the previous route.
